transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, I came in because... I just keep having these thoughts lately. It's like I keep thinking my family might be better off if I just didn't wake up. And, honestly, it scared me enough that I ended up telling my supervisor at work about it. So, that's why I'm here.
Are you thinking about killing yourself right now?

No, I don't have a plan to actually do it. Like I was just saying, it's more that I keep having these thoughts about just... not waking up at all. It's just this heavy feeling that they'd be better off without me around. I'm not sitting here about to hurt myself, but having those kinds of thoughts in my head was enough to scare me into getting help.
Did these thoughts start after something stressful happened in your life?

Yeah, I suppose so. This whole change in me has been going on for about two weeks now. That was right around the time my daughter left Georgia to go into the military. So, it pretty much started right after she shipped out.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day?

Well, I guess... I wouldn't say I feel depressed most of the day. I mean, I'm just not really sure if that's what it is. It's more about those thoughts I mentioned. I just feel heavy, like I said, but I haven't really noticed feeling down all day long.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to spend time messing with my tomato plants out back, or sanding wood at my work bench. I'd watch the Falcons play, or stay after church just talking with folks... but lately, I don't know. I just look at all that stuff and it's like it belongs to somebody else. I just don't have any drive to do any of it right now.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?
No, not really. I've been sleeping okay, actually. I mean, I go to bed and wake up about the same time I always do. So, sleep hasn't really been an issue for me.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work or take care of things at home?

Yeah, it really has. At work... well, my mistakes started getting pretty serious. It got to the point where a supervisor found me just sitting out in my truck before dawn one morning, and they ended up getting occupational health involved over it. And at home, it ain't much better. I've just been letting bills and other responsibilities pile up on the counter instead of handling them like I normally would. I just can't seem to get to them right now.
Before these last two weeks, have you ever had another period like this in your life?

Yeah, looking back on it, I suppose they have. These kind of low stretches have been coming around for about a year now. But... well, this particular one, right after my daughter left... it's definitely hit me the hardest.
When those earlier low stretches happened over the past year, did any one of them last for at least two weeks?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I didn't exactly mark them down on a calendar. They just sort of came and went, you know? I couldn't tell you if they lasted exactly two weeks or not.
Over these last two weeks, have you been feeling sad or depressed?

I don't really think so. I mean... I wouldn't say I've been feeling sad or depressed, exactly. I haven't really noticed feeling like that, to be honest with you. It's not like I'm sitting around crying or anything.
Have you been feeling especially anxious or on edge lately?
No, not really. I wouldn't say I've been nervous or on edge. I haven't really noticed feeling anything like that, to be honest.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?

No, my energy has been fine. I mean, I get regular tired at the end of a long day at work, sure, but... nothing unusual, no. I've got plenty of energy to get through what I need to do. I haven't been dragging or anything like that.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?

Well, I don't know if worthless is exactly the right word, but... I do feel like a failure. I just keep going over my daughter leaving, over and over in my head. I keep telling myself I must have failed her somehow. Like... a better father would have done something different, you know? It just weighs on me.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?

Yeah, I have. At the distribution center where I work, I'll just sit there and stare at the schedule or the routing sheet, and my mind... it just won't lock in. It's frustrating. Because of that, even making little staffing calls ends up feeling a whole lot bigger and harder than it ought to.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?

Yeah, it's dropped off quite a bit. Most days I really have to make myself eat just a few bites. Even the food I normally like, whether I'm at the warehouse or at home... it just sits there until I eventually throw it out. I just don't have any interest in it right now.
Before this current stretch, have you ever had another period in your life when these symptoms lasted at least two weeks?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had rough days before, like anybody, but... not like this. I've never had a time where I felt this down and out for weeks on end. This is really the first time it's ever hit me this hard.
Have you been moving or talking more slowly than usual lately?

Yeah, I have. People at work actually keep asking me if I'm sick. They tell me I'm walking a lot slower, and... I guess I'm taking forever just to answer simple questions on the floor. It honestly just feels like my whole body is moving through mud.
